advisories.summary: Erigon 3 does not upgrade an Erigon 2 datadir. Re-sync. Caplin archive flags and prune flags changed, and the built-in consensus client is on by default.
advisories.action: Re-sync. Replace caplin.backfilling, caplin.backfilling.blobs, and caplin.archive with --caplin.states-archive, --caplin.blobs-archive, and --caplin.blocks-archive. The v3.0.0 notes spell the blobs flag --capin.blobs-archive. Use --prune.mode (full, archive, or minimal). Pass --externalcl to disable the built-in consensus client. Polygon checkpoint sync is on unless you pass --polygon.sync=false.

advisories.summary: Removed startup flags now prevent launch. Polygon chain names and bor/polygon flags are rejected. amd64 binaries require x86-64-v2. Fresh datadirs persist receipts.
advisories.action: Remove --fcu.background.commit and --experimental.streaming-commitment. Move Polygon to 0xPolygon/erigon. Use an x86-64-v2 CPU (SSE4.2 and POPCNT). For a new datadir, pass --prune.include-receipts=false to keep the old disk-saving default. If --caplin.checkpoint-sync.disable is set, allow checkpoint sync for this upgrade or re-sync Caplin.

advisories.summary: Custom graffiti is prefixed with client identification unless you opt out. QUIC listens on UDP 4001 by default and refuses to start if that port is already the discovery port.
advisories.action: Allow UDP 4001, or set --caplin.discovery.quicport (standalone Sentinel: --sentinel.quic.port). If --caplin.discovery.port is 4001, move QUIC first. Pass --beacon.api.preserve-graffiti to keep all 32 graffiti bytes. No re-sync from 3.7.0. Sepolia Caplin must be on this release before Oct 6, 2026, 13:53:36 UTC.
